description: This file implements functions for managing a vector (list) of objects targeted for deletion, including initialization, destruction, adding objects, handling failures, and checking path group consistency in a data model manipulation context. It is part of a broader software component related to group deletion operations in a data model.

methods.name: void GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_Init(group_del_vector_t * gdv)
methods.description: Initializes a group_del_vector_t structure by setting its vector pointer to NULL and number of entries to zero.

methods.name: void GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_Destroy(group_del_vector_t * gdv)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with the given group_del_vector_t, including all individual path and message strings.

methods.name: void GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AddObjectsToDelete(group_del_vector_t * gdv,str_vector_t * obj_paths,int_vector_t * group_ids)
methods.description: Adds a list of object paths and corresponding group IDs to the deletion vector, transferring ownership of the path strings.

methods.name: void GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AddObjectNotDeleted(group_del_vector_t * gdv,char * obj_path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds an entry for an object path that failed to delete, including error code and message.

methods.name: bool GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AreAllPathsTheSameGroupId(group_del_vector_t * gdv,int * single_group_id)
methods.description: Checks whether all paths in the vector belong to the same data model provider group, returning true if they do, and outputs that group ID.

methods.name: group_del_entry_t * GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_FindFirstFailureIfAllFailed(group_del_vector_t * gdv,int index,int num_objects)
methods.description: Checks if all objects in a given slice of the vector failed to delete; if so, returns the first failure entry.
